name: Xinjiang Tianfu Energy Co., Ltd.
summary: Xinjiang Tianfu Energy Co., Ltd. engages in the production and supply of electricity, heat, natural gas, and water in China. It has a total installed capacity of 5,801 megawatts comprising 231 megawatts of hydropower, 2,890 megawatts of thermal power, and 2,680 megawatts of photovoltaic power, as well as 300 megawatts of photovoltaic power under construction. The company also owns centralized heating, urban water supply, and urban natural gas pipeline networks. In addition, it is involved in construction activities. The company was formerly known as Xinjiang Tianfu Thermoelectric Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Xinjiang Tianfu Energy Co., Ltd. in July 2014. Xinjiang Tianfu Energy Co., Ltd.…
